areas.name: Annavölgy
areas.note: Broad inhabited/recreational valley nucleus along Annavölgyi út and Bükkös-patak, located by municipal notices and saved actual access tracks. Hillside/forest transitions are inferred; no claim to map the entire drainage valley or the separate Annavölgy municipality.

areas.name: Izbég
areas.note: Broad Izbég residential valley/hillside estimate anchored to the saved Szentlászlói/Sztaravodai road axes and Bükkös stream corridor. The source plan uses a combined Izbég–Csicserkő context; this rough locality does not assert that all combined planning land is identical to Izbég. Southeastern transition around the separate estates is inferred.

areas.name: Kertváros
areas.note: Garden-city street group around Lévay and Lehel between the stream and Szentlászlói corridor. Public street maps identify these streets as Kertváros; perimeter links near the northern estate and southern river bend are inferred. The separately named Bükköspart geometry is not treated as an alias.

areas.name: Püspökmajori lakótelep
areas.note: Compact apartment-estate envelope around the internal Hamvas/Fehérvíz/Széchenyi roads explicitly listed in municipal cleaning-service material. The surrounding whole Püspökmajor character/planning district is not reused under this smaller estate name; outer open-space edges are approximate.

areas.name: Rózsakerti lakótelep
areas.note: Small first apartment-estate group near the HÉV terminus, located by municipal tourism history and the Duna-korzó planning map. Saved estate access streets and surrounding main roads anchor the rough envelope; adjoining riverfront open space is not represented as an exact cadastral estate boundary.

areas.name: Skanzen
areas.note: Museum-quarter envelope inferred from the identified75ha museum campus, its actual saved path/road groups, Sztaravodai access and adjacent stream. The whole campus/current property boundary has not been independently reproduced; northern open-space and southern transition links are approximate. No building-only footprint or point buffer is used.

areas.name: Vasvári-lakótelep
areas.note: Compact Vasvári estate around the actual Templom/Deák road loop and municipal street membership. Edges follow the visible estate access/street ends approximately. The broader statutory Füzespark street triangle may overlap this historical small estate; the two distinct names remain separate.
